Definition: an Eranite or descendant (collectively) of Eran
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, ʻÊrânîy means an Eranite or descendant of Eran. It occurs just once, in Numbers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʻÊrânîy is best left as Scripture leaves it: Eranite or descendant of Eran.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
